name: LABORATORY BALL MILL
desc: Desktop-Type Laboratory Ball Mill engineered for uniform mixing, particle size reduction, and ultra-fine grinding of diverse chemical powders. Outfitted with an interchangeable SS304 grinding jar supporting a capacity up to 2 kg, driven by a Fractional Horsepower (FHP) motor.
features: Heavy-duty interchangeable structural jar holding up to 2 Kg sample volumes
Supplied complete with multi-sized high-grade Stainless Steel grinding balls
Industrial-grade heavy-torque Fractional Horsepower (FHP) continuous motor
Integrated automated high-accuracy RPM controller adjustment module
Built-in programmable mechanical/digital Batch Timer tracking from 0 to 60 Minutes

specifications.Equipment Configuration: High-Performance Benchtop Mechanical Laboratory Ball Mill Workstation
specifications.Primary Process Function: High-efficiency mixing, micro-grinding, and milling of solids and liquids
specifications.Acceptable Sample Formats: Versatile processing optimized for dry powders, chemical gels, and liquid matrices
specifications.Grinding Chamber Jar Capacity: Heavy-duty interchangeable structural jar holding up to 2 Kg sample volumes
specifications.Chamber Contact Material (MOC): Premium corrosion-resistant and non-contaminating Stainless Steel (SS304 Grade)
specifications.Grinding Media Infrastructure: Supplied complete with multi-sized high-grade Stainless Steel grinding balls
specifications.Jar Maintenance Profile: Ergonomic quick-release configuration that is easily removable and changeable
specifications.Primary Mechanical Drive Engine: Industrial-grade heavy-torque Fractional Horsepower (FHP) continuous motor
specifications.Velocity Control Framework: Integrated automated high-accuracy RPM controller adjustment module
specifications.Process Operational Timer: Built-in programmable mechanical/digital Batch Timer tracking from 0 to 60 Minutes
specifications.Electrical Power Inputs: Standard 220 Volts AC, 50 Hz, Single Phase stable Indian plug mains connection
specifications.Chassis Structural Build: High-durability vibration-absorbing structural steel base framing structure
specifications.Target Field Applications: R and D Laboratories, Pharmacy Formulation, Chemical Assays, and Metallurgy Labs
specifications.Warranty Cover Protection: 1 Year Comprehensive On-site Manufacturer Warranty on FHP drive motor and speed panel
